svg.title: Hassam Zahid, AI Engineer
svg.desc: Open to AI Engineer roles. Karachi, PK. I turn scattered business tools into one AI-powered workflow. Production AI systems: RAG assistants, MCP integrations, voice agents and n8n automation, with the FastAPI backends and Next.js frontends that put them in front of users. Diagram: GoHighLevel, Salesforce, ElevenLabs, Fathom, Asana, n8n, Twilio, Maqsam, pgvector, MCP, Claude API, OpenAI API feeding one agent core.
